start.title: [TODO:fr] Wilderness of Rephidim
start.text:
[TODO:fr] The wells are dry. Lips crack with dust.
The people gather, eyes hot.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Pretend you do not see them

scold_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Mercy First
scold_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] Anger will not fill empty jars.
Turn your ear to their cry.

ignore_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] See Their Faces
ignore_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] A shepherd does not hide from sheep.
Look upon their suffering.

people_complain.title: [TODO:fr] "Why Bring Us Here?"
people_complain.text:
[TODO:fr] "Did you lead us out to die of thirst?"
Stones rest in trembling hands.

strike_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Not With Your Hand
strike_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] Their cry belongs before the Lord.
Lay it at His feet, not yours.

moses_prays.title: [TODO:fr] Alone on the Hill
moses_prays.text:
[TODO:fr] Wind moves over the silent slope.
You wait for His answer.

demand_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Ask, Do Not Demand
demand_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] Water falls only from open hands.
Kneel and bring their need.

despair_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] He Still Hears
despair_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] Your weakness is not the end.
Speak the people's pain to Him.

god_speaks.title: [TODO:fr] "Go to the Rock"
god_speaks.text:
[TODO:fr] His voice is steady as the dawn:
"Strike the rock. Water will come."

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Doubt the word and search for wells
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] His promise needs no other path.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Ask the elders to act for you
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] He spoke the word to you.

doubt_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Trust the Word
doubt_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] The Lord does not speak in vain.
Go where He has sent you.

shift_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] He Sent You
shift_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] Obedience cannot be passed on.
The staff is in your hand.

approach_rock.title: [TODO:fr] Before the Stone
approach_rock.text:
[TODO:fr] The great rock stands silent and bare.
The camp watches from afar.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Boast you will draw the water
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] It is the Lord, not you.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Strike in His name as commanded

boast_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] His Glory, Not Yours
boast_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] The water will flow from heaven.
Lift His name above your own.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Strike in His name as commanded

water_flows.title: [TODO:fr] Living Water
water_flows.text:
[TODO:fr] Stone splits. A clear stream rushes out.
The dry ground drinks first.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Hold the water back from the people
[TODO:fr] Call the people to come and drink

withhold_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Open the Stream
withhold_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] Mercy is for thirsty mouths.
Let every soul come and drink.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Call the people to come and drink

people_drink.title: [TODO:fr] The Camp at the Spring
people_drink.text:
[TODO:fr] Children laugh. Old hands tremble.
Clay jars fill to the brim.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Take the credit before them all
[TODO:fr] Lift their eyes to the Lord

credit_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Name the True Source
credit_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] The stream is not from your hand.
Let His name fill their mouths.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Lift their eyes to the Lord

silent_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Tell of Him
silent_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] Mercy unspoken can be forgotten.
Name the One who gave the water.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Lift their eyes to the Lord
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] The camp grows still to listen.

ending.title: [TODO:fr] Massah and Meribah
ending.text:
[TODO:fr] Where they doubted, He provided.
The rock still pours its mercy.
